aboutUs.subtitle: Our Story
aboutUs.title: Crafted with Passion & Precision
aboutUs.paragraph1: At Cindy Handmade, every stitch carries a piece of our heart. We were born from a deep love for traditional crochet craftsmanship — specializing in beautifully handcrafted crochet products that bring warmth, charm, and a touch of uniqueness into your everyday life.
aboutUs.paragraph2: Each item is carefully made to order using only premium-quality yarns, ensuring your piece is not just beautiful but truly one of a kind.

aboutUsPage.heroSub: Every thread woven with purpose. Every piece made with love.
aboutUsPage.introQuote: We don't just sell products — we pour our hearts into every stitch, creating crochet pieces that bring warmth into your everyday life.
aboutUsPage.value1Desc: Every single stitch is made with steady, patient hands — never rushed, never outsourced. Only slow, intentional craft.
aboutUsPage.value2Desc: We source only the softest, highest-quality cotton and acrylic yarns to ensure your piece feels wonderful and lasts beautifully.
aboutUsPage.value3Desc: Each item is made especially for you after your order — so you always receive something truly fresh and personal.
aboutUsPage.step1Desc: Every piece begins with carefully selecting premium yarns — soft to the touch, rich in colour, and built to last.
aboutUsPage.step2Desc: Stitch by stitch, each product is handcrafted with patience and attention to detail, ensuring every curve and texture is just right.
aboutUsPage.step3Desc: Before reaching you, every piece is inspected, cleaned, and carefully packaged — wrapped with the same love that made it.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our products, shipping, and more.

items.question: Are all your products handmade?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely! Every single item at Cindy Handmade is 100% hand-crocheted with love, care, and attention to detail. We do not use any machines in our crafting process.

items.question: What kind of yarns do you use?
items.answer: We carefully select premium-quality yarns for all our products. We primarily use soft organic cotton, milk cotton, and high-quality acrylic blends to ensure our items are safe, durable, and gentle on the skin, especially for babies.

items.question: How long does it take to receive my order?
items.answer: Since our items are made-to-order, it typically takes 3-7 days to craft your piece depending on the complexity. Shipping usually takes an additional 2-5 business days within the country.

items.question: Do you accept custom orders?
items.answer: Yes, we love bringing your unique ideas to life! You can contact us directly via our social media pages or email to discuss custom colors, sizes, or completely new designs.

items.question: How should I wash and care for my crochet items?
items.answer: We recommend hand washing your crochet items in cold water with a mild detergent. Gently squeeze out excess water (do not wring) and lay it flat to dry. This helps maintain the shape and softness of the yarn.
